# Jiyology Building Construction & Plumbing - Complete Reference

> Professional construction and plumbing contractor based in Soweto, Johannesburg, South Africa. SABS approved, BEE Level 1 compliant (50% black woman owned). Specializing in roofing, plumbing, paving, tiling, painting, ceiling installation, and home renovations for residential, commercial, and industrial clients.

- [Home](https://www.jiyology.co.za): Main landing page for Jiyology Building Construction & Plumbing. Overview of services, company highlights (SABS approved, BEE Level 1), and calls-to-action for quotes and consultations.

Business hours: Mon-Fri 8:00-17:00, Sat 8:00-13:00, Sun closed. Includes contact form and Google Maps embed with exact coordinates.

## Services

- [All Services Overview](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Complete catalog of service categories with detailed descriptions, feature lists, and imagery.
- [Roofing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/roofing): Roof tile installation, IBR/Chromadek sheeting, complete roof erection for new builds, and roof repair. All materials SABS approved. Soweto and Johannesburg.
- [Roof Repairs](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/roof-repairs): Leak detection, storm damage restoration, tile replacement, and flat roof waterproofing.
- [Plumbing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/plumbing): Routine maintenance, emergency repairs, new installations, pipe replacements, geyser repairs, and blocked drain clearing.
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/emergency-plumbing): 24/7 response for burst pipes, blocked drains, geyser failures, and sewer backups across Soweto and Johannesburg.
- [Geyser Installation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/geyser-installation): New geyser installs, replacements, solar geyser systems. Kwikot and Heat Tech brands.
- [Paving](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/paving): Driveway paving, patio and walkway paving, interlocking brick, and commercial paving.
- [Tiling and Painting](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/tiling-painting): Floor tiling, wall tiling (ceramic, porcelain), interior and exterior painting for residential and commercial clients.
- [Ceiling Installation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/ceiling-installation): New ceiling installation, drop ceilings, bulkheads, and ceiling repairs for residential and commercial buildings.
- [Home Renovation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/renovations): Kitchen remodeling, bathroom upgrades, interior and exterior renovations.
- [Construction](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services/construction): Residential new builds, extensions, and commercial construction.

## Blog & Guides

- [How Much Does It Cost to Build a House in Soweto?](https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/cost-to-build-house-soweto): R8,500–R15,000/m². Full breakdown: foundation, roofing, ceilings, plumbing, tiling, plans, NHBRC fees, and hidden costs.
- [How Much Does a New Roof Cost in Soweto?](https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/how-much-does-roof-cost-soweto): Roofing cost breakdown by material (concrete tile, IBR, Chromadek) and roof size for Soweto and Johannesburg homes.
- [Building Plan Approval in Johannesburg](https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/building-plan-approval-johannesburg): When you need permits, City of Johannesburg submission process, costs, timeline, and penalties for unapproved work.
- [Concrete Roof Tiles vs IBR Sheeting](https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/concrete-roof-tiles-vs-ibr-sheeting): Cost, durability, insulation, noise, and lifespan comparison for Soweto homes.
- [How to Find a Reliable Contractor in Soweto](https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/find-reliable-contractor-soweto): 10 essential checks — NHBRC verification, references, red flags, and contracts.
- [Signs Your Geyser Needs Replacing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/signs-geyser-needs-replacing): Warning signs it's time to replace rather than repair a geyser in South Africa.
- [How Often Should You Service Your Geyser?](https://www.jiyology.co.za/blog/geyser-service-frequency-south-africa): Service every 2 years, replace anode every 3–5 years. Prevents bursts and saves electricity.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- What areas does Jiyology serve? Jiyology primarily serves Soweto, Johannesburg, and the greater Gauteng metropolitan area in South Africa, covering approximately a 50km radius from their Emdeni South location.
- Is Jiyology BEE compliant? Yes. Jiyology is a BEE Level One company with 135% BEE recognition. The company is 50% black woman owned and operates as an equal opportunity employer.
- Are materials SABS approved? Yes. Jiyology exclusively uses SABS (South African Bureau of Standards) approved products and materials across all projects, ensuring compliance with South African quality and safety standards.
- How do I request a quote? Clients can request a free quote by calling (011) 931 0157, emailing vusi@jiyology.co.za, or submitting the contact form on the website at https://www.jiyology.co.za/contact.
- What roofing services are offered? Jiyology provides roof tile installation, roof sheeting (IBR and corrugated), complete roof erection for new construction, and roof repair services for existing structures.
- Does Jiyology handle emergency plumbing? Yes. Jiyology offers emergency plumbing services including burst pipe repairs, blocked drains, geyser repairs, and other urgent plumbing issues in the Soweto and Johannesburg area.
- What are the business hours? Monday through Friday: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday: 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.
- Who founded Jiyology? Jiyology was founded by Vusi Jiya and Lerato Jiya, who are passionate about delivering quality construction and plumbing services to their community.
